module: Flowgraph node "Multiseat" (category once_instant, no pin). Enables the 'multiseat' setting once (workOnce) while saving the previous value, then restores it when graph execution stops.

_executionStarted.desc: Resets self.activated to false when the graph starts.

workOnce.desc: Reads the 'multiseat' setting (default false), stores it in self.previous then sets 'multiseat' to true via settings.setValue.

_executionStopped.desc: If the node had enabled multiseat, restores the original value of the setting.
